title: Cancel: terminate the process tree, then record canceled from the launcher's terminal evidence
outcome:
Cancel -> TerminalProcessTree::kill_before_reap (job object / process group) -> bounded wait -> read results.json; record state canceled with reason 'canceled by <session/user>'; TermAl never writes into the run dir.

REVIEW FIXES (F2): after TerminateJobObject / killpg the launcher writes nothing: results.json remains state running with the killed stage running and later stages unrun, no ended; `summary` prints UNKNOWN. TermAl records the host verdict canceled + reason 'canceled by <session/user>' (sticky across boot) and never touches the run dir.
acceptance:
- Grandchild processes are gone after cancel (fixture spawns a grandchild).
- results.json stays running/unrun for the killed run; the record is canceled with the reason; `summary` on that dir prints UNKNOWN.
- Cancel of a terminal (passed/failed/canceled/unknown) run -> 409.
